main_text.l: Apparet crebro, spondet noua tempora celat. Scandit turba rogat. fors quoque bina cadit.
2 Barbara quæque suam nunc audit natio linguam. Ioël & Dauid. corpora multa lauant.
3 Claudipedem sanat prædulcis nomen Iesu. Hortaturque reos ad meliora Petrus.
4 Declaras Petre vim Iesu, spernisque minantes. Cumque tuis oras. propria nullaquibus.
5 Expirant duo mendaces. iuuat umbra reclusi Quæruntur loqueris non male Gamaliel.
6 Fit grave pro viduis murmur, septemque ministrans. Testes in Stephanum quæ didicere citant.
7 Grandia perstringit Stephanus mysteria paucis; Quem ceu blasphemum perfida turba necat.
8 Infestat Saulus. credit Simon, arguiturque. Labilis Eunuchum dum legit, unda beat.
9 Lux tibi Saule datur periturum sportula seruas. Saluus es Aenea, functa puella redit.
10 Monstrat Corneli tibi Petrus quid sit agendum. Et monitus visis, teque, tuosque lauat.
11 Narrat facta Petrus culpantibus Antiochem[?] Credunt, atque Agabo est mox fore visa fames.
12 Occlusus rediit, mirantur, res male vexas Custodes, sæda morte Tyrannus obit.
13 Paulus seligitur. Bariesum corripit, idem Multa docet gentes inde repulsus abit.
14 Quæstus in Iconio. Lystrensis claudus, honores Exhibiti lapides, presbyterique dati.
15 Religio Mosi, Petro suadente, vexatur. Disiungit Marcus, lite calente, duos.
16 Spiritus ire vetat. Macedo astat. Lydia credit. Pytho fugit, rupti carceris ima tremunt.
17 Thessalonica fidem recipit. Berrhæaque fœlix. Cecropiis monstras Paule salutis iter.

page.notes: Printed lines are numbered 1 to 17 in the left margin, and each numbered entry is a two-line couplet. The initial A of "Apparet" is a large woodcut letter, joined to the word. Doubtful readings: "Antiochem" (line 11) and "Cecropiis" (line 17) are hard to read at this scan resolution; "functa" (line 9) and "vexas" (line 12) are read with some uncertainty. The long s in "reclusi" and "seruas" is given as plain s. Text on the left edge belongs to the neighbouring page and is not transcribed.
